title: Kula Today
heading: Yesterday · Wed 04 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 08:15 to about 16:45. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 4,400 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,300 ft by the Kekoa camera, 900 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 4,900 ft, off by 400 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 12:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools; furthest south about 17:22, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 2 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 21 of 55 updates.
